content.text: There is a table somewhere, written in someone else's hand. I try to read it, but the letters shift like water bugs across the surface — names half-formed, numbers dissolving at the edges. I ask again. The ink settles differently this time, still imperfect, still alive with uncertainty. A small note at the bottom warns me: some errors may remain. I think about all the truths I've tried to hold that refuse to stay still, that blur when I look too closely, that ask only for a gentle核对 — a checking, a verifying, a willingness to look twice. Perhaps that is the only lasting thing. The act of returning. The soft persistence of trying.
